cues.text: What if preview was the import?
EstateCRM reads the bytes of your Excel or CSV file, not its name.
Columns are matched by header text, and a Meta lead ads file is named.
Change any guess yourself, and the numbers recompute before a single row is saved.
The preview runs the same code the import runs, so these counts hold.
Nothing reaches your CRM until you press the button, and then it matches.
The preview is the import. Try the import preview.
